context: A mom teaches her young son to make breakfast in the kitchen
purpose: Teach: 牛乳/サラダ/キッチン/チョコ/食っ/栽培/分解/望ん

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔ちゃん、今日は一緒に朝ごはん作ろうか。まず冷蔵庫から牛乳パック出してくれる？
lines.en: Sho, let's make breakfast together today. First, can you grab the milk carton from the fridge?
lines.style: Warm motherly tone, gentle inviting and patient with her child

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん！ねえママ、ぼくチョコ味のシリアル食べたい！甘いの大好きなんだ！
lines.en: Okay! Hey mom, I want the chocolate-flavored cereal! I love sweet stuff!
lines.style: Bright excited child voice, slightly whining and full of energy

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、甘いものばっかりじゃダメよ。サラダも作るから、レタス洗うの手伝って。おばあちゃんが栽培した野菜なの。
lines.en: Haha, you can't have only sweet things. We're making a salad too, so help me wash the lettuce. Grandma grew these vegetables herself.
lines.style: Patient teaching voice, slightly playful and lovingly firm with him

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: えー、サラダきらい…でもおばあちゃんの栽培したやつなら食べる。ねえ、キッチンってなんで道具いっぱいあるの？
lines.en: Ehh, I hate salad... but if grandma grew it I'll eat it. Hey, why does the kitchen have so many tools?
lines.style: Childish complaint shifting to curious wonder about the kitchen

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: それぞれ役割があるのよ。包丁で食材を細かくしてあげると、体の中で分解しやすくなって元気が出るの。
lines.en: Each one has its own job. When you chop ingredients small with a knife, your body can break them down more easily and it gives you energy.
lines.style: Calm educational explanation, motherly and warm while teaching him

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 分解？むずかしいことば！ぼくパンケーキずっと望んでたんだよ、はやく食べたい！
lines.en: Break down? That's a hard word! I've been wishing for pancakes forever, I want to eat them quick!
lines.style: Energetic childish enthusiasm, impatient and bouncing with excitement

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: はいはい、ちゃんと作るから待っててね。牛乳と卵を混ぜて…翔も混ぜる？昨日パパが朝ごはん食ってたの覚えてる？同じやつよ。
lines.en: Yes yes, I'll make them properly, just wait. Mix the milk and eggs... want to mix, Sho? Remember dad was eating breakfast yesterday? Same thing.
lines.style: Soft amused agreement, inviting participation in the cooking together

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: やる！ぐるぐる、ぐるぐる…ママ、ぼく将来キッチンで働くコックさんになる！
lines.en: I'll do it! Round and round... Mom, when I grow up I'm going to be a chef working in a kitchen!
lines.style: Joyful determined child declaration with proud bright energy
